full.description: This is a medical diagram illustrating the classification systems of aortic dissection. It shows schematic representations of the aorta with intimal tears propagating along the ascending and descending sections. The classifications depicted are the DeBakey and Stanford systems. These diagrams are commonly used to categorize aortic dissections based on their anatomical extent and involvement of the ascending aorta.

random.description: This is a medical diagram illustrating the classification systems of aortic dissection. The image shows the aorta and its major branches categorized into different types according to the DeBakey and Stanford classification schemes. The diagrams depict varying locations of the intimal tear and the extent of the false lumen along the ascending and descending thoracic aorta. It is typically used for educational or clinical reference to describe the anatomical types of aortic dissection.
